BundleVersion.description: Version of the immutable presentation-bundle contract.

PresentationDocumentScope.description: Semantic DOM extent present in one immutable browser artifact.

oneOf.description: The browser document contains the complete authored film.
The browser document contains exactly one independently planned region.

PresentationFrameBehavior.description:
Proven cadence at which browser-owned pixels may change.

Unknown presentation code requires `PerFrame`. Placement-bounded pixels may
change only when the browser plan changes its active structural placements,
so execution may reuse one exact capture between those boundaries.

oneOf.description: Browser-owned pixels may differ at every authored frame.
Browser-owned pixels are constant between placement boundaries.

PresentationTemporalCapability.description:
Proven relationship between a presentation's output and requested frames.

Unknown presentation code requires `Sequential`. Random access is an
explicit claim that each requested frame depends only on immutable inputs
and that exact frame.

oneOf.description: Frames must be evaluated as one screenplay-ordered sequence.
Any requested frame can be evaluated independently.

PresentationVisualCapability.description:
Proven relationship between browser presentation pixels and primary media.

Unknown presentation code requires `BrowserComposite`. A separable layer
explicitly limits browser ownership to one side of native media.

oneOf.description: Chromium owns the complete frame, including primary media.
Chromium owns only the browser backdrop beneath native media.
Chromium owns only a transparent foreground over native primary media.

description: Stable description of one immutable presentation artifact.
